purpose: Executable ledger for the `topology-dimension-signature` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Dimension rows make dimension, spectral dimension, dimensional reduction, critical dimension, 3+1 recovery, and scale-dependent dimension language auditable but cannot promote a route beyond its state-machine ceiling.

dimension_rows.dimension_object: Dimension, effective dimension, spectral dimension, manifold dimension, critical dimension, map dimension, apparatus dimension, or benchmark feature dimension used by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
dimension_rows.dimension_estimator_or_recovery_rule: Declare whether dimension is topological, Hausdorff, spectral, thermodynamic, causal-set estimator, critical/compactified, EFT input, laboratory background, survey/cosmology assumption, learned feature dimension, or metadata-only. State scale dependence and estimator dependence explicitly.
dimension_rows.scale_or_flow_dependence: Dimension may depend on RG scale, diffusion time, causal interval size, triangulation phase, coarse-graining, simulator target, map pipeline, compactification radius, or public-record scale; such dependence caps fixed-dimension support.
dimension_rows.dimension_failure_mode: Failure can appear as spectral-dimension evidence mistaken for manifold dimension, 3+1 public records mistaken for candidate-native dimension recovery, dimensional reduction retold as observed-sector closure, or critical/compactified dimensions mistaken for unique candidate identity.
dimension_rows.dimension_test: Compare dimension estimators, scales, regimes, and target objects; require compatibility with observed-sector recovery rows before using 3+1, emergent dimension, dimensional reduction, or critical-dimension language as support.
dimension_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer spacetime recovery, observed-sector recovery, UV completion, or ToE identity merely from one dimension estimator, one scale, or one fixed background dimension.

dimension_rows.dimension_object: File counts, route counts, graph sizes, table widths, and summary dimensions of the archive package.
dimension_rows.dimension_estimator_or_recovery_rule: Metadata dimensions are audit metrics only; they are not spacetime dimension, spectral dimension, manifold dimension, critical dimension, or observed-sector dimensional recovery.
dimension_rows.scale_or_flow_dependence: Metadata counts can change with release refactors and therefore cannot transmit physical dimension credit.
dimension_rows.dimension_failure_mode: Treating graph/cardinality counts, directory depth, or route-table dimensions as evidence of physical dimensionality.
dimension_rows.dimension_test: Confirm that metadata-dimensional quantities are always routed through custody/audit language, not physical support language.
dimension_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer physical dimension, dimensional reduction, 3+1 recovery, or candidate-native dimension from metadata counts.
